original_constraints.label: Quality Management Certification
original_constraints.requirement: Must hold a currently valid ISO9001 or IATF16949 certificate (not expired, not suspended).
original_constraints.rationale: Non-negotiable quality-system gate required by the end customer's automotive-adjacent supply chain policy.

original_constraints.label: Minimum Monthly Production Capacity
original_constraints.requirement: Must be able to sustain at least 20,000 units/month.
original_constraints.rationale: Below this threshold the supplier cannot cover ramp-up volume without a second source; treated as a capability gate, not a negotiating point.

original_constraints.label: Minimum Quality History Score
original_constraints.requirement: Must have a quality history score of at least 85 (out of 100, based on defect rate / audit history / on-time delivery of prior lots).
original_constraints.rationale: Track record below this score has historically correlated with field failures for enclosure parts; not commercially negotiable.

original_constraints.label: Maximum Minimum Order Quantity
original_constraints.requirement: MOQ should be no more than 5,000 units.
original_constraints.rationale: Preferred ceiling for initial pilot batches; suppliers above this can often be negotiated down or split across a phased PO.

original_constraints.label: Maximum Lead Time
original_constraints.requirement: Lead time should be no more than 45 days.
original_constraints.rationale: Desired for launch schedule but expeditable freight or partial shipments can often close a small gap.

original_constraints.label: Acceptable Manufacturing Regions
original_constraints.requirement: Must manufacture in one of: North America, Western Europe, Southeast Asia.
original_constraints.rationale: Preferred for tariff exposure and logistics; a strong supplier outside these regions could still be considered with a landed-cost review.

original_constraints.label: Minimum Sustainability Score
original_constraints.requirement: Sustainability score should be at least 60 (out of 100, based on emissions reporting, energy sourcing, waste handling).
original_constraints.rationale: Aligns with buyer ESG goals; can be waived for an otherwise strong supplier pending a corrective action plan.
